title: A shell keeps its open top face when the extrude under it gets a taper

expect.note: Same volume as building the final steps in their own order (the extrude tapered 3 degrees first, then the 1.5 mm shell on the same open top face): 3549.785453991189 on FreeCAD 1.1.4. FreeCAD alone loses the name of the face when the taper is added ("?Edge4", the step goes red); SciForge remembers where it was (saved in the file) and finds it again.
